name: Baseline
tagline: Show up. Look the part. Get out of your way.

children.text: You need a site that's fast, clean, and credible — one that does its job when someone looks you up, and doesn't need a developer to keep alive. That's Baseline.

inclusions: 5–7 pages designed and written for your business
Static stack — no WordPress, no plugins, no security patches
Hosting, SSL, and DNS managed for you
Contact form routed to your inbox
A monthly report a human actually wrote
